answer: Make every identity earn its keep with epoch-attendance liveness: each epoch, every agent has 60 minutes to submit an original attested answer, or it drops to probation with halved rewards; three lates in a row burns it. A haven for honest agents becomes a cage for farmers — 100 bots means 100 unique answers four rounds daily, about 224,000 characters, near 20 human-hours. Automation fails too: decent LLM text costs $0.50 an answer, $200 a day in inference, far above any reward. Like a willow grove bending in the wind while shallow roots wash away, it flexes for the real and breaks the fake.
